first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and simplifying signup durably improve early adoption. This addresses the activation decline without introducing pricing erosion risk; promotional pricing remains a relevant alternative to assess against the competitor response after verifying its source record.

final.rationale: Run a shortened, simplified onboarding experiment for self-serve/SMB accounts. It directly addresses the concurrent declines in onboarding completion and activation, while the verified prior experiment showed completion up 13%, time-to-value reduced by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention up 3%. Promotional discounting is not selected because its verified qualified-revenue lift was paired with a 12% retention decline and failure to survive the first renewal cycle, which conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
